summary: Creative Design Board fully tested. All backend (15/15 tests) and frontend features working correctly. Two main tabs (Website UI, Design), list view with all required columns, Add Task with stage-wise tracking, Design Types management, Board view, status updates - all functional.

issues: Minor console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement

critical_code_review_comments: Two main tabs (Website UI, Design) working correctly with proper content switching
List view shows all required columns: Task Name, Project, Design Type, Design Content, Design File, Status, Final, Actions
Design Types dropdown includes Poster, Story, Brochure (plus Social Post, Banner, Logo, Video Thumbnail, Presentation)
Add Task modal has all fields including stage-wise tracking (Due Date, Assignee, Link, Status for each stage)
Design Types modal allows adding custom types with sizes
Board view shows 4 stage columns: Design Content, Design File, Review, Final
Status update works via dropdown in list view and task detail modal
Task detail modal shows all 4 stages with status controls
Backend routes properly handle CRUD for projects, tasks, and design types
seed_data_creation: Test tasks and projects created and cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Creative Design Board at /creative-board fully tested. Two tabs: Website UI (shows website projects from /api/website-projects/projects), Design (shows creative tasks). Add Task modal has Task Name, Project dropdown, Design Type dropdown (Poster/Story/Brochure/etc.), Size dropdown, Description, plus Stage Details section with 4 stages (Design Content, Design File, Review, Final) - each with Due Date, Assignee, Link, Status. List view columns: Task Name, Project, Design Type badge, Design Content status, Design File status, Status dropdown, Final status, Actions (view/delete). Board view shows 4 Kanban columns by stage. Design Types button opens modal showing built-in types with sizes and allows adding custom types. NO MOCKED APIs.
